description: The AP2 `delegate_payload` form (one array disclosure) with the same placeholder digest twice in the signed payload. RFC 9901 §7.1 step 4: "If any digest value is encountered more than once in the Issuer-signed JWT payload (directly or recursively via other Disclosures), the SD-JWT MUST be rejected". Measured 2026-10-28 on 1.6.0: both verifiers valid: true, the mandate twice in resolved_claims. 1.7.0 (SPEC §6 step 2): that artifact's error, the pack is not valid.
